purpose: Close the semantic gap between storage identities and instruction-result values before the general emitter. Mutable locals and fixed arrays are storage; reads create result values and writes consume source values. The physical candidate aligns with the existing verified reference IR: every generic LOAD/STORE carries an explicit index value, and that index may be tryte or i64 exactly as accepted by the current verifier.

reference_ir_alignment.load_shape: LOAD result=<fresh value> operands=(index_value,) memory=<storage identity>
reference_ir_alignment.scalar_storage: memory length 1; index operand is an explicit typed constant zero, normally tryte zero in the reference lowering
reference_ir_alignment.fixed_array_storage: memory length equals fixed extent; index is an explicit tryte or i64 semantic value
reference_ir_alignment.semantic_index_rule: The source semantic analyzer and the reference IR verifier both accept tryte or i64 array indices. Stage1 must preserve the actual semantic index value/type; no implicit narrowing is required merely to match the reference verifier.
reference_ir_alignment.rule: Do not multiply physical opcodes when generic LOAD/STORE plus explicit memory identity and index operand preserve the same semantics.

storage_model.parameter: immutable semantic value available at function entry
storage_model.scalar_local: stable LOCAL_STORAGE_IDENTITY represented as length-1 storage; logical LOAD_LOCAL means physical LOAD(storage_id, typed_zero_index) -> fresh result; logical STORE_LOCAL means physical STORE(storage_id, typed_zero_index, source_value_id)
storage_model.fixed_array_local: stable LOCAL_STORAGE_IDENTITY with element type and fixed extent; logical LOAD_INDEX means physical LOAD(storage_id, index_value_id) -> fresh result; logical STORE_INDEX means physical STORE(storage_id, index_value_id, source_value_id)
storage_model.compound_assignment: lower to explicit LOAD + arithmetic/comparison + STORE; no implicit mutable-current-value lane
storage_model.array_initializer: lower deterministically to a verified initialization form or ordered STOREs with explicit constant index values
storage_model.phi_policy: SSA phi nodes are not required for mutable storage itself. Instruction-result values remain single-definition values; control-flow joins observe mutable storage through explicit LOAD operations.

physical_opcode_candidate.scalar_index: explicit typed constant zero; reference lowering normally emits tryte zero
physical_opcode_candidate.array_index: explicit tryte or i64 semantic value
physical_opcode_candidate.indexed_discriminator: verified storage extent/shape rather than absence of an index operand
physical_opcode_candidate.store_result: none unless language semantics separately require one
physical_opcode_candidate.storage_reference: explicit local/storage identity; never recovered from source

array_requirements: index expression is a semantic value ID, never a raw-source token
element type is derived from verified local metadata
fixed extent is preserved in local metadata
index value type is tryte or i64 exactly as accepted by semantic analysis and verifier
verifier proves statically-known constant indices are in range where the representation exposes that fact
dynamic indices follow documented runtime bounds semantics
indexed STORE source type equals array element type
indexed LOAD result type equals array element type
scalar_requirements: scalar mutable local is length-1 storage
every scalar LOAD/STORE has exactly one explicit index operand
scalar STORE carries source value after the index operand
scalar LOAD produces a fresh semantic result value

definition_kinds.LOAD_RESULT: defined by a generic LOAD instruction
definition_kinds.CALL_RESULT: defined by a result-producing call instruction

use_rules: every value operand references a populated semantic value header, never an extension-only physical slot
parameter values may only be used by their owning function
storage identities may only be accessed by instructions owned by the same function
instruction-result values have exactly one defining instruction
instruction-result definitions dominate every use under the final CFG; constants and parameters are entry-available
STORE does not redefine the storage identity and does not fabricate a second semantic value
CALL arguments preserve lowering order and reference semantic value IDs
RETURN_VALUE references a defined value compatible with function return type
CONDITIONAL_BRANCH references a defined condition value and same-function target blocks
verifier_order: decode and range-check all value headers
decode and range-check all local/parameter metadata
decode storage objects and establish owner/type/extent/mutability
decode blocks and establish block-to-function ownership
decode instructions in deterministic block order
establish exactly-one definition for each instruction-result value
validate generic LOAD/STORE memory identity and exact operand cardinality/order
validate scalar zero index and array index type/bounds semantics
reject any wide-literal extension slot presented as a semantic value ID
reject overflow, truncation, namespace collision, or source reconstruction
fail_closed_cases: local scalar value consumed directly from LOCAL_STORAGE_IDENTITY with no LOAD
scalar LOAD/STORE missing explicit zero index
scalar LOAD/STORE using nonzero or non-tryte/non-i64 index
array element consumed with no LOAD carrying explicit index value
array element written with no STORE carrying explicit index and source values
STORE operands reversed relative to physical index,value convention
STORE to immutable storage except verified initialization
instruction result referenced before or outside its valid CFG definition
same semantic result ID defined by more than one instruction
constant out-of-range index when statically knowable
call argument references storage identity where a loaded scalar value is required
return or branch condition references storage identity where a scalar value is required
